blind.description: A tall, narrow wooden bookcase designed as a secret door, fitted with two large iron hinges along one outer edge. The front features five open shelves loaded with colourful stylized books standing upright, slanted, and stacked horizontally. The outer frame is medium-brown wood with a molded cornice at the top and a molded base plinth at the bottom. The back of the unit is closed with panelled wood. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean low-poly stylized geometry with hand-painted textures, sitting completely flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow brown rectangle showing the top wooden crown moulding of the bookcase with a subtle center groove/split line.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times the height of the figure (roughly 6 ft to 6 ft 4 in tall), and roughly 0.4 times the figure's height in width.
